# indiefa.st

> Curated indie maker tool directory — one hand-picked tool per journey stage from idea to scale, plus Grow sub-tracks for automate, scale, community, support, SEO, and distribution.

indiefa.st helps solo founders and indie hackers discover, validate, build, ship, monetize, measure, and grow products without tool-list paralysis. Each stage has editorial blog guidance and affiliate-backed tool picks with discounts where available.

## Full documentation

- [Complete LLM reference (text)](https://indiefa.st/llms-full.txt): All 52 tools with pricing, reasoning, affiliate URLs, blog posts, navigation, and site metadata
- [Complete LLM reference (markdown)](https://indiefa.st/llms-full.md): Identical content to llms-full.txt

## Featured tool picks

- Marblism (11. Grow): YC-backed platform of 7 named AI Employees for SMBs. Eva (inbox/calendar), Sonny (social), Stan (leads), Penny (SEO), Rachel (calls), Walter (websites), Linda (contracts). Autonomous with approvals; from $24/mo. 60k+ businesses.
- Systeme.io (9. Monetize): All-in-one platform for entrepreneurs: build sales funnels, send unlimited emails, host courses, run affiliate programs, create websites, and automate marketing.
- SocialRails (11. Grow): Post to 9 platforms from one dashboard. AI writes captions, generates images, and builds videos from 350+ templates. Scheduling, analytics, team collab.
- Outrank.so (11. Grow): Programmatic SEO automation that generates blog posts backlinks and optimization recommendations on autopilot to grow organic traffic while you sleep.
- Turbo0 (8. Ship): Directory of popular content creation products where startups list their tool for discovery and a DR 81 backlink; ~5k products listed and ~75k monthly pageviews.
- ClickFunnels (9. Monetize): Sales funnel builder platform to convert online visitors into paying customers with optimized landing pages checkout flows and marketing automation.
- Mangools (2. Research): Affordable all-in-one SEO tool suite for keyword research SERP analysis rank tracking backlink checking and competitor analysis across LLMs.
- Feather.so (11. Grow): Platform to publish SEO-friendly blogs from Notion collect emails and send high-deliverability newsletters with no coding or design skills required.
- Outseta (9. Monetize): All-in-one membership and SaaS platform combining CRM email marketing payments authentication and customer management for scaling businesses.
- pCloud EU-LTD (7. Backend): Secure European cloud storage: files stored in the EU under strict privacy laws, accessible anytime from any device, with 20 GB free to start.
- pCloudPass (7. Backend): pCloud's password manager: store and access your passwords and personal data from one secure place, on the web and across your devices.
- PostSyncer (11. Grow): Social media scheduling tool managing Instagram Facebook LinkedIn TikTok Pinterest YouTube Telegram BlueSky Threads, X and now Mastodon with AI video creation.
- Testimonial.to (11. Grow): Platform to collect text and video testimonials from customers with ease and embed them on websites without developer or hosting needs.
- MailerLite (11. Grow): Email marketing platform with transactional emails automation newsletters landing pages websites and forms for growing audience engagement.
- Revid.ai (11. Grow): Create viral videos in Minutes! Turn your creative ideas into attention-grabbing TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube stories with just a few clicks. All you need is a story to tell - revid.ai handles the rest.
- UptimeRobot (10. Measure): An uptime monitoring service that continuously checks websites, APIs, and other endpoints. It alerts you in real-time when anything goes down, degrades, or changes.
- RedShip (11. Grow): Turn Reddit users into customers. Monitor conversations where people are looking for solutions like yours. Turn Reddit into your best acquisition channel.
- Uneed.best (8. Ship): Daily launch platform where makers launch products every day and users discover, upvote and review the best new tools, apps and startups.
- Ranked AI (11. Grow): Managed SEO + PPC service with software. Human team writes content, builds links, and fixes issues; tracks Google + AI search visibility (ChatGPT etc.). From $99/mo per site.
- Postiz (11. Grow): Agentic social media scheduler. AI agents plan, generate, and schedule posts to 30+ networks; human reviews in one calendar. Open-source option; starts ~$29/mo.
- Firecrawl (7. Backend): Web data API for AI agents. Search, scrape, or crawl any site into clean Markdown/JSON. Handles JS rendering, anti-bot, and dynamic content for RAG and agents.
- Subscribr (11. Grow): All-in-one YouTube production platform. Finds outlier ideas, writes scripts in your voice, designs thumbnails, and edits/renders finished videos. Agent-friendly; free tier available.
- Linkto (8. Ship): Unlock Explosive Growth with this FREE List of 800+ SaaS Directories and 75+ Launch Sites
- Chrome Goldmine (1. Discover): A complete database of 9,656 expired Chrome extensions - each with revenue estimates, rebuild difficulty, competitor gaps, and a step-by-step launch plan.
